content: 15:1-11 Munon inubersiau tari der bugamorei
Io, see ye bo Qenu qob uber qoan qemerine igumon eng bo sabar ete qemerine igar qamb. Qob uber eng igumon end see an nonoguret igoumon.
Qob uber eng igumon end mom oabig igamari Qenu an qo anqubei anubersiarei. Eng an oau apand ue ende qi eng ue qi.
Qob qamar aninob qamam eng qoan yonob qamarari igom eng. Munon inubersiau tari eng wo umb ininou qomon boru eng birogoniamor Qenu qob igoa gas ende.
Uma tumuniamirei igama qen ombur gari ubura bo igomot der bugamorei. Qenu qob qoan igoa gas ende.
Der bugab Pita qamar wot dibent ne wonou wuriimbigau yurau 12-eng wurit dibentarei.
Ne qen geret wonou yurau bubun wot oabigumir eng qangang 500 wotanami gamirei.
Ne bo qen geret Yems gea ne wonou wuriimurima gim qib igour eng gugum gamirei.
Ne mom sasam eng ye munon uber ue, munon boru end yet dibenara gamei.
Ye Yisas wonou imbigau yurau eng igamari ye boru ooirut end igoum. Ye qoan Qenu munon yurau wuriba sumungasi igoum end munon yet Yisas wonou yurau ende yet qomorunor eng misue.

Ego Qenu wonou uyes yeseara see ar me igoum. Wo ye mi eb qamb ye musier eng ar isi wugine me igo. Ye sarau qeretutnob ebet igoum. Yisas wonou yurau qei sarau ebet igour eng wuritanami ebet igoum. Ego sarau eng ebet igoum eng yonou ai qorut ue, Qenu wonou yenonogursia ebet igoum.
Mi eng gagar mai, ye ebet igoum qiyo, wuri ebet igour qi eng song. Eng qob gari eng wuri qamarari ye qamb igoum eng an igub oabig igoumon.
15:12-34 In bo der bugomboun
Qenen in Munon inubersiau tari eng umb wogub bo igomot der bugamor end aninob qumurune an qei der: “Munon umb bo maigas at igomot der bugombour?” qamb igoumon.
Munon umb igomot me der bugumunorei qamb gab eng Munon inubersiau tari eng igomot me der bogomau qomoruboun.
Munon inubersiau tari me der bugamorei ende qi eng in bo meimet qamb an oabigar qamb aninob me qumurunei.

Yisas me der bugamorei ende qi eng in munon qei wurimirimoar quraun qi. Eng, in Qenu apand Yisas meniamor end qanam dibes qamb qib igoun. Qenu in munangit me inmenimba ende qi eng Munon inubersiau tari gor me menimau qi.
In ete qamb gab eng: “Qenu munon umari me wurimeni igo.” Ende qamb gab eng Munon inubersiau tari eng me menimau ende qomoruboun.
Qenu Munon inubersiau tari me meniamorei ende qi eng aninou oau apand eng me annonogursierinerei. Aninou qomon boru eng ar ten igoumon qi.
Ne gor, munon wot oabig igo umumir eng gor mom uburubour.
End in ag et igom igamau end gari igub Munon inubersiau tari wot oabigoun ende qi eng in sarau ar isi isiner qamb munon gugum borusi in toubar igorubour.
Ego, Qenu wo Krais menima der bugamor eng apand ar. Munon umb igour eng wo gigit werei barsitar der bugamorei. Mani qen yar igo gas ende.
Munon ger munon umau werei eng imotarerei, ne bo munon ger munon umb igomot der bogomau eng imotarerei.
Eng ete: Adam yurau eng umau eng, a Krais yurau eng bo igomot igamau eng.
End ne in gari-gari ininou oau apand end igomot der bugomboun, Krais wo gigit, wo bo yonam deriner qen end in wot oabigun end der bugomboun.

Qen sasam yara mi gugum uburiba, gabman sarau ne munon uber wonou sarau mom uburiba, baraitari wurinou sarau ne mi gagam gab igoun eng gugum uburiba. Ubura ne wonou mi bibis big igoar eng gugum wonou Ur Qenu wot waga qoat igoriba.
Munon inubersiau tari wo munon baraitari igo ne munon qarau wurugumutumai ugeiba.
Wo ende at munon qarau qei wurugumutumai ugab ne gor umau qomon eng gor aba uburiba.

Ende Qenu qob ete igo. “Qenu mi gugum wo wot waga wonou mom qubei igoriba.” Qob eng igo end ne Qenu mi gugum wot waga qoat igo. Ne ur wo wau nonogursia mi gugum qoat igama ne wo gagt gab igo. Ur wo der mi eng gagar garisi igama wau der me qoat igo, ur wonou wesopur igo.
Mi gugum Munon inubersiau tari eng wot waga mom qubeima gab ne Qenu wonou bo wonou wau eng nob mi gugum sori wuriqubei ne wo wonou baraitari aib gigit igoriba.

End ne mai, munon umb bo igomot me der bugombari ende qi eng munon qei see igom igour eng wuri mai obouboun? Wuri eng mai meimet qamb munon qei ar qo umumir eng uput qamb munon qei nob qamarari ya obotar wurimaragansi igour? Munon umb bo igomot me der bugombari ende qi eng wurinou qomon ar isi isiba.
Ne see in gor umb bo me der bugumunei ende qi eng meimet qamb ar benau wugune munon qei ende inquguragsi igorubour?
Io, ye qenen umau gas ende igoum. End anit mismisir qob apand aninob quraum. In gugum Munon inubersiau tari Yisas nob igoun end mismisir dibes ende aninob quraum.

Ye mi geret big aninob qemeribam eng: Ye Epesus end igo iau qaar wurinob yogub igoum eng mai meimi uber ger baib qamb at igumei? Munon umb bo igomot me der bugab igamari ende qi eng ye gor barim umibam end see song ye mani qamb nub mismisir igo barim eng song umb wegin ende qamb ende ebet igoribam.
Munon qei anmurimar qomorunor qamb qoyametarar. An munon qomon boru ebet igour eng wurinob garisi qib igamari aninou qomon uber eng ba songesiorubour.

An misir song-song eng wogub misir qoregen eng imbigar. Qomon boru bo sabar me abar. An munon yurau erogori end qei Qenu me imbig igour. End ye qob eng at qemerine qei igub aninou qomon end qinininguboumon.
15:35-58 Git goan der bogomau eng wonomi wes
Munon qei ete qebi qomorubour: “Munon umb maigas at der bugombour? Der bugomunor eng wuri git goan maigas igoriba?”

Ende qamarari an qanganget gab eng an nanasingir qur goanet igoumon end imbigar. Nanasingir qur gonari qaur di qur eng mom uburab ne aibet isari git ombomai yar igo. Ar geren ai erobon igoriner eng qaur di git me ariterinerei.
Mi qur gugum goanet igoun eng im isar, qen qamb eng diban gab me goanet igoun, qur qas goanet igoun.
Ne Qenu wonou qoyam end mi gugum aba im isar qen qamb eng aba wes-wes di igour.
Git goan gugum qeemben ue, munangit git goan wonou wes, a wai wuri git goan wes. Ne morogan wurinou wes, ne yag wai wurinou wes ende igour.
Ne mi erer qite ne ag e gaun eng sig uber ar. Mi erer qite git goan wonou wes igour ne mi ag e wonou wes igour.
Worom gaun eng wonou goan wes, ne inaun gaun eng wonou goan wes, ne tapai wuri irou end goan wurinou wes-wes sig maieng gab igoun.
Munon bo igomot der bugombour eng, eng gas ende. Git goan tumuni igoun eng biet isub igo, ne git goan igomot der bugeminer eng bo me bierinerei.
Git goan tumuni igoun eng uber ue ne gagam ue. Ne git goan igomot der bugeminer eng sig maieng ne qiribiten.
Git goan tumuni igoun eng ai e wonou. Git goan igomot der bugeminer eng Igomurur wonou.

content.text: Git goan ombur igour, ger ag e wonou, ger Qenu ginamt igoriner eng wonou.
End Qenu qob ete qamb igo: “Adam qamar eng git goan igomot igamau eng qanam.” Ne bo Adam ger eng Munon inubersiau tari eng wo umb igomot der bogomau eng wonou tari.
End umb igomot der bogomau eng gigit me darimau. Git goan igom igamau eng gigit dariamorei, ne umb igomot der bogomau eng qanamt.
Munon qamar Adam eng wo Qenu ai ba barsiarei. Adam bubun ger bo dariamor eng wo wonou munon erer qite, Qenu ginam wogub dererei.
In see ag e igoun eng Adam wonou tumbigi end igoun. Qen geret igomot der bugomun eng Munon inubersiau tari Qenu ginam wogub derer eng wonou iitari igoruboun.
See igoun eng Adam wonou git goan gas ende igoun. Qen geret bo Munon inubersiau tari wonou git goan gas ende igoruboun.

content: Io, ye qob eng apand aninob quraum, munon ag e me oabigunor eng Qenu wonou bibis end me irunorei. Ne gor mi ag e boruburab igo eng Qenu ginamt mi uber igo eng nob morogot me igorunorei.
End ye qob qi ger aninob qemeribam eng igar: In gugum me umb uburunei, git goan qas igeser bo bubun buruboun.
Qen sindomund end ain mer sasam gusimari qand munon umburiamir eng der bogomari ne in gugum git goan qas igeser bo git goan bubun buriba.
Ete: git goan see igoun eng umb igo end ne bo qen end wonou bo igeser uber qenen bebereg igamau end bo igeseremba.
Git goan e biet igo eng bo ninirneri bo uber igomot qenen bebereg igoriba. Qenu qob ete igo eng irimanimba: “yogorau umau eng nob Qenu wotanamiamorei.”
Umau qomon, mai igom igamau nob yogub wotanamimba qiyo? Umau qomon, mai inongoara uter iningeriba qiyo?
Qomon boru eng wagar gas ende iningara umb igoun. Qomon gugum igo end ne qomon boru igo.
End ne Qenu init igub ininou Munon Aib Yisas inubersiau tari eng imurima der innonogursier end in qomon boru eng nob yogub wotanami igoun. End Qenut uber qamb igorun.

Io, end ne an mom du qamb igo ne Munon Barai wonou sarau eng ebet igoarar. Wonou sarau see ebet igoumon eng ar isi me isinerei. Ende imbig ne Munon Barai wonou sarau eng qenen qeretutnob baab igoarar.
